name: text-highlight
title: Text Highlight
description: Animated emphasis on one span inside a static sentence — marker sweep, color shift, underline, strikethrough-replace, or shimmer.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-highlight?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
